subject.title: feat(discord): add canvas-first Discord Activities support

question: Should Discord Activities be implemented by hardening this PR on the Canvas plugin contract, or should this branch pause in favor of a narrower redesign/replacement?
rationale: The unresolved blockers are not routine cleanup: they require choosing the owner boundary for Canvas Activity config/routing and the acceptable security model for public Discord Activity access, token transport, SDK loading, and fanout limits.

options.title: Redesign on Canvas plugin contract
options.body: Move Activity config/routing into the Canvas plugin, require verifiable or tokened auth, remove URL token transport, bundle or pin the SDK, and add fanout limits before merge.

options.title: Accept a core-root exception
options.body: Maintain the root/core implementation only with explicit owner approval, documented upgrade behavior, and security signoff for the new public Activity access model.

options.title: Pause or close both Discord Canvas branches
options.body: Close or pause this PR and the older overlapping draft until a small owner-approved architecture is written down.

recommendation.title: Redesign on Canvas plugin contract
recommendation.body: Move Activity config/routing into the Canvas plugin, require verifiable or tokened auth, remove URL token transport, bundle or pin the SDK, and add fanout limits before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is recent Canvas plugin migration plus adjacent Gateway and Discord component ownership.
